The top-right shows a clear cassette with handwritten text on the label and visible mechanical details. The bottom-left shows a silver/grey metallic-looking cassette with complex internal mechanisms visible. The bottom-right shows a light blue/clear cassette with a yellow label containing gibberish text. All subjects are rigid plastic objects with internal spools.
